question: Unsang permit ug security clearance ang kinahanglan kuhaon kung magpahigayon ug fun-run o motorcade sa siyudad?
answer: Ang unsang permit at ang security clearance na kinahanglan kuhaon kung magpahigayon ug fun-run o motorcade sa siyudad ay nakalistado sa [S1] at [S2]. Ang permit na kinahanglan ay ang Business Permit (private agency) (organizer) at ang security clearance ay makukuha sa Public Safety and Security Command Center. [S1] at [S2] ang mga nakalagay na source ng mga impormasyon.

ground_truth: A Special Mayor's Permit is required for events involving groups of people such as concerts, bazaars, fun-runs, and motorcades. General requirements include Public Safety and Security Command Center clearance, organizer business permit, and an Affidavit of Undertaking.
